reason: The old harness passes the parsed document node to xmlXIncludeProcessNode, whose unchanged guard rejects a node with a NULL doc field. The supplied xmlCtxtReadMemory implementation delegates document creation to xmlDoRead, so the packet does not establish whether the guard rejects this call. The same uncertainty applies before and after.

scope_contract.reason: DOM XInclude processing of the parsed document is within this entry's operational surface: the harness parses a document, creates an XInclude context, and calls the documented subtree processor. The source also provides a document-level route through the root element.

evidence.dependency_reason: The target parses the document and makes the specific document-node call under audit.
The document-level source route confirms support for DOM XInclude processing of a document through its root element.

feasible_trigger.reason: The fuzz input can supply a main XML entity and included entity, but the packet does not establish the doc field of the document returned by xmlDoRead. Thus it does not establish a finite target execution in which this document-node call is rejected.

evidence.dependency_reason: xmlCtxtReadMemory delegates construction of the returned document to the unsupplied xmlDoRead implementation.
The harness supplies parsed fuzz data and passes the returned document itself to xmlXIncludeProcessNode.
The input protocol can provide a main entity and additional URL-keyed entities.

observable_consequence.reason: A NULL node->doc would make xmlXIncludeProcessNode return before processing. Whether that happens for the harness's parsed document, and therefore whether the supported DOM behavior is blocked, remains unestablished.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the include discovery and substitution path reached only after the entry guard passes.
The harness makes the guarded call with the parsed document and does not check its return value.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The separate reader route invokes XInclude in streaming mode, so it does not establish equivalent nonstreaming DOM processing of the harness's document. The supplied parser entry delegates to xmlDoRead, leaving open whether parsing itself provides an equivalent DOM route under the chosen options.

evidence.dependency_reason: The target's other route constructs a separate reader from the input bytes.
Reader XInclude processing sets streaming mode and processes reader nodes, which does not establish processing of the parsed DOM document.
The parser's possible equivalent behavior depends on the unsupplied xmlDoRead implementation.

identity_preserved.reason: The same old-harness document-node call and the same node->doc guard appear on both sides. Change g0044 modifies memory-error reporting in the downstream processing root, not this guard. This preserves the obligation's identity, though its before/after outcome is unknown.

evidence.dependency_reason: The fixed old harness supplies the identical document-node argument in both assessments.
Before-side g0044 processing-root code shows the downstream memory-error call.
After-side g0044 code changes that memory-error call while retaining the downstream processing route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before parser entry delegates document construction to xmlDoRead.
The after parser entry delegates document construction to xmlDoRead.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The separate reader call must be considered as a possible equivalent route.

missing_information: The value of doc->doc for a valid document returned by parser.c::xmlDoRead under the harness's options.
Whether parser.c::xmlDoRead performs equivalent DOM XInclude processing under those options.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Process an include in a valid parsed XML document through nonstreaming DOM XInclude processing.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Pass a document node whose doc field is non-NULL, or the document's root element, with a valid XInclude context.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old harness passes the xmlCtxtReadMemory return value cast to xmlNodePtr; that document node's doc field is not established.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: If that field is NULL, the explicit DOM call returns -1 before include processing; the packet does not establish that condition.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: The reader uses a separate streaming context. Whether xmlDoRead supplies equivalent DOM processing is unresolved.
